mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) over a 3-month horizon signals a strengthening consumer demand environment that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 growth decelerates below 0.5% quarter-over-quarter in the subsequent 3 months, the signal should be invalidated, and 20-day forward returns should not exceed baseline levels (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) over a 3-month horizon signals weakening manufacturing output, which negatively impacts corporate earnings and economic growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO rebounds above its 3-month low by more than 1.5% in the subsequent 3 months, the signal should be invalidated, and 20-day forward returns should not be significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over a 3-month horizon signals a tightening monetary policy that increases discount rates, reducing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS remains unchanged or declines below the 3-month high in the subsequent 3 months, the signal should be invalidated, and 20-day forward returns should not be significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over a 3-month horizon signals weakening labor market conditions, which negatively impacts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE declines below its 3-month high by more than 0.5 percentage points in the subsequent 3 months, the signal should be invalidated, and 20-day forward returns should not be significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).
